subject: Symmetry Labs - demo image packaging & metering intake
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@symmetrylabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 29 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Symmetry Labs - demo image packaging & metering intake

Hi Maria — great to connect last week. As discussed, Symmetry wants to list a co-sell-enabled offering across AWS & Azure and we need to align on packaging, metering, and the Private Offer path. To keep things actionable, here are the specific asks from our side: 

- Packaging: do you have an AMI build (AWS) and a managed container image (ECR/ACR) we can validate? If not, we can provide an AMI checklist and a small demo VM image we host.
- Metering: we need SKU mapping and any usage tags (tenant_id, plan_id) so Marketplace metering events can be correlated back to your billing.
- Co-sell/Private Offer: confirm whether you want Azure Private Offer + AWS Private Offer or AWS Marketplace Seller private offers only.
- Demo image: a small, self-contained demo image (1 vCPU, 2GB) that we can use for joint demos would speed certification.

Attaching our initial intake artifacts: symmetry-technical-specs.pdf and ami-build-checklist.xlsx — they include our packaging expectations and a short validation script. Please send your environment details and any constraints (e.g., licensing, preloaded datasets) so we can draft the mutual action plan.

Next steps: if you can reply with the environment readme and preferred timeline (2–4 week target preferred), we’ll schedule a technical onboarding with our Partner Engineering team.

Thanks,
Priyom
Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.inference
(attachment: symmetry-technical-specs.pdf)
(attachment: ami-build-checklist.xlsx)

From: Maria Gomez <maria@symmetrylabs.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 07:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Symmetry Labs - demo image packaging & metering intake

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the 2–4 week cadence; legal will want the Private Offer paperwork in parallel but that shouldn't block technical work. Quick answers below: 

- Packaging: we currently have a private AMI and a container image in ECR. We'll export the AMI manifest and provide ECR image tags.
- Metering: we use an internal tenant_id and plan_code; we'll map those to SKUs. Expect a CSV from us with mapping fields.
- Private Offer: we would like both Azure Private Offer and AWS Private Offer enabled initially.
- Demo image: we can produce a trimmed demo image (single-tenant, no PII) within 5 business days.

Attaching our environment primer (symmetry-environment-readme.md). Will cc our partnerships inbox with legal and our platform engineer (cc: partnerships@symmetrylabs.com).

Proposed next step: please share a HubSpot/MAP link or a shared Drive where we can drop evidence; otherwise I can send a zipped bundle. Also confirm a time for a 45-min technical onboarding this week (we're available Wed/Thu afternoons ET).

Best,
Maria Gomez
Head of Partnerships | Symmetry Labs
maria@symmetrylabs.com
(attachment: symmetry-environment-readme.md)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Symmetry Labs - demo image packaging & metering intake

Looping in a quick internal triage so we keep momentum. Maria confirmed both AMI and ECR + wants Azure & AWS private offers. Action items below (assignments):

- Ben: lead on metering/SKU mapping. Please prepare a mapping template that includes: marketplace_sku, redwood_product_id, symmetry_plan_code, meter_event_key. Reach out to Maria for the CSV. Target: 3 business days.
- Priyom: I'll need you to own the co-sell enablement path (Azure Private Offer checklist + AWS Private Offer steps). Draft the mutual action plan and legal touchpoints.
- I'll coordinate Partner Eng time for the onboarding session and reserve a 45-min slot Wed 10am PT / Thu 1pm PT. Priyom, confirm which slot works and I’ll send calendar invites.

Notes: We should ask Symmetry for a sanitized demo image (no customer data) — Maria says they can turn this around in 5 business days. Also request an expected ARR band so we can size co-sell support.

Vivek
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Symmetry Labs - demo image packaging & metering intake

Thanks Maria — perfect. Sharing the mutual action plan + evidence dropbox and a couple of meeting options.

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) This week: Symmetry delivers environment primer + demo image (sanitized). (owner: Symmetry)
2) Partner Eng onboarding (45 min) to validate AMI/ECR and run the ami-build-checklist.xlsx. (owner: Redwood)
3) Metering CSV from Symmetry and SKU mapping from Ben. (owner: Symmetry + Ben)
4) Marketplace certification (AWS/Azure) and Private Offer paperwork routed to legal. (owner: Redwood + Symmetry Legal)
5) Joint go-to-market plan + co-sell enablement (owner: Redwood GTM + Symmetry Partnerships)

I uploaded a skeleton evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-symmetry-evidence — please drop the AMI manifest, ECR tags, sanitized demo image, and the metering CSV there. Also starting the HubSpot record: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/DEAL-2028-1123.

DocuSign for our Private Offer NDA: https://www.docusign.com/rc/ACME-SYMMETRY-PO (Maria, if legal can sign that in parallel we can start the seller registration).

Available onboarding slots: Wed 10:00am PT / Thu 1:00pm PT. I’ll tentatively pencil Wed 10:00am PT and send an invite once Maria confirms.

Attachments: symmetry-technical-specs.pdf, ami-build-checklist.xlsx (see attachments in prior message).

Thanks — Priyom
Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
(priyom@redwood.inference)
